question: How does Śiva liberate the individual self from its bondage?
premises: The individual self is bound by a net of bonds.
Śiva wields the trident of power.
Liberation requires the removal of bonds.
inference: Śiva liberates the individual self by tearing apart its net of bonds with the trident of power.
plain_english: Having torn apart the net of bonds of the individual self with the trident of power, Śiva liberates it.
